rationale: The completed train-only substitutions establish compensation between coefficient blocks. The correction estimates all shared retained coefficients from observed train momentum, with causal full-val checkpoint selection and unchanged frozen recovery thresholds.

scientific_scope.matched_controls: Four unchanged frozen starts and one known-parameter equation in each population.
scientific_scope.fit_inputs: Observed train q/v, constant power, equilibrium and registered mass/graph priors. No hidden truth, true coefficients, function-error targets, labels or test data enter identification or selection.
scientific_scope.supports: Previously selected supports remain fixed. Each retained optional amplitude is refitted jointly; absent amplitudes remain exactly zero.
scientific_scope.observation_span: Use every available 10 ms train observation through 8.1 seconds. Build integral equations every 50 ms and at the final available frame, with event-equal weighting.
scientific_scope.interpretation: Fixed-support coefficient recovery; this scope does not repeat the earlier function-family selection experiment.

equation_review.projection_identity: C=P diag(g) and mass-COI velocity imply C^T v=diag(g) v. Input validation enforces this identity before fitting.
equation_review.memory_identity: The integrated memory force is P diag(h) g^2 + P diag(E) w0, with h the exponential convolution of q(t)-q(0), E=tau*(1-exp(-t/tau)), and w0=g*z0.
equation_review.visible_terms: Linear damping uses the exact D*(q(t)-q(0)) endpoint integral. Modulated damping uses the exact edge primitive e/2-sin(2e)/4. Sine force uses cubic Hermite interpolation from q/v and fixed eight-point Gauss quadrature per observed interval.
equation_review.optional_coordinates: Harmonic a and raw modulated damping b/8 are bounded in [0,2]; the implementation multiplier 8/45 maps the latter to the physical b/45 term.
equation_review.nuisance: Independent unconstrained w0 is eliminated by QR within each train event. It is neither exported nor used to initialize val/test predictions.
equation_review.gradient: The envelope gradient differentiates h and E at the optimized shared linear coefficients and nuisance moments. The implementation includes the event weight and tau chain-rule factor for log_tau.

numerical_contract.input_checks: Nonempty finite records, positive finite train scales, balanced power, finite equilibrium, and mass-COI visible observations.
numerical_contract.bounded_solver: Column-scaled Cholesky reduction; exact unconstrained optimum when feasible, otherwise BVLS with tolerance 1e-12 and at most 200 internal iterations. Check projected stationarity against 1e-9 times max(1, infinity norm of the scaled RHS).
numerical_contract.unsupported_design: Report numerical failure; no diagonal jitter, hidden-state truth substitution, data removal or silent coefficient repair.
numerical_contract.forecast: Original three-GN initializer with eleven observed frames and visible reset at 100 ms. GPU float64 formal scoring uses 2.5 ms and 1.25 ms through the complete 8-second forecast.

iterative_contract.method: L-BFGS-B on log_tau with analytic value/gradient and initial-train-objective scaling.
iterative_contract.full_val_cadence: Initial-tau linear optimum, every tenth accepted iteration, and the final accepted point without duplicate evaluation.
iterative_contract.val_objective: Event-equal, channel-normalized MSE, equal weighting of the complete 1-second and 3-second forecasts at a 5 ms integration step.
iterative_contract.selection: Earliest strict minimum finite full-val objective; no truth-function or kernel error enters checkpoint selection.
iterative_contract.stopping: Registered SciPy tolerances, accepted-iteration cap, distinct-objective cap, or explicit numerical failure. Cached evaluated states are distinct from the accepted optimizer state; cap termination retains the last accepted state.
iterative_contract.evidence: Retain objective/gradient/conditioning traces, actual and selected accepted iterations, each monitored log_tau and physical coefficient vector, and full-val per-event scores.

recovery_gates.null_original_a: The separate calibrated null A must pass the same recovery conditions.
recovery_gates.known_controls: Preserve original train/val known-parameter trajectory, history, hidden-state, truth-step and trajectory-label/trigger agreement requirements.
recovery_gates.all_models_physical: Preserve original energy-balance, nonnegative dissipation and positive local mass-COI curvature gates for all eleven frozen equations.
recovery_gates.complete_reporting: After freezing, score every declared train, val and test event for every model, including failed or uncovered predictions. Full-cohort invalid metrics remain null. Test results are reporting-only.

budget_reconciliation.failure_isolation: Formal-scoring bounds include one failed batch plus each event isolated once. Full-val monitoring has one batch attempt per checkpoint.
budget_reconciliation.accounting: Momentum counters count logical solver calls; frozen BVLS and L-BFGS-B internal iteration limits bound work within each logical call.

execution_boundaries.required_prior: Consumed, accepted coefficient-substitution diagnosis with the exact bound run and artifact manifest.
execution_boundaries.real_follow_up: All four corrected equations and the known/physical controls must satisfy their registered synthetic gates. Then register and independently review the exact TASK3 A/B fitting, full-val selection and complete train 346/val 107/test 76 evaluation scope before real execution.

review_evidence.engineering_validation: Coordinator reports seven focused tests passed. Reviewed their source: analytic convolution, tau derivatives, zero input, variable-length records, constrained envelope-gradient finite difference, mass-COI fixture and objective-cap finalization.
